items.note: No mention of slide-gate approach velocity, fish screens, or relocating screens outside the gated openings.
Matches 14-15 mgd firm capacity and proposes replacing/adding a pump with VFD to reach 18 mgd firm.
Matches 12 mgd treatment limit with higher hydraulic capacity and proposes a second parallel 12 mgd basin.
Proposes Filters 5-6 and full-rate filter-to-waste piping, but uses a 3 mgd filter rating and additionally requires a seventh filter for firm 18 mgd.
Engineers find the clearwell adequate to 18 mgd with no change, while the agent finds it deficient and adds 85k gal plus CT/baffling work.
Matches nominal 10 mgd and true firm about 11.2-11.5 mgd, but proposes two 2800 gpm pumps plus upsizing No.1 and further uprating rather than adding 4 mgd and 6 mgd VFD pumps to reach firm 18 mgd.
Matches the 14 mgd surge rating limit and proposes upsizing/adding a larger surge vessel for 18 mgd operation.
